# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides — Package Tracking

> 2 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Package Tracking. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Package Tracking

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/package-tracking/overview/): If you sell tangible goods, send tracking information for PayPal transactions as soon as you ship items to your customers.
- [Client-side configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/package-tracking/client-side/): Here is an example that demonstrates client integration and can be used for any Server integration for creating user approval.
